tool_input.command:
for f in machtzev/generator/apps/peruk*.json; do
  count=$(jq '.entities[0].fields | length' "$f" 2>/dev/null)
  name=$(basename "$f" .json)
  echo "$name: $count fields"
done | sort -t: -k2 -rn
